name: tsuga
description: Tsuga observability plugin: querying Tsuga data (TQL, aggregation bodies, PromQL, docs lookup) and running the `tsuga` CLI; investigation of incidents, service health, errors, latency and traces; configuration audits; building dashboards, monitors, SLOs, routing and other assets; getting telemetry in with OpenTelemetry SDKs, the Collector and OTTL; designing what to measure and how to verify it; and meta-skills for building and validating skill bundles.
